description:
We have a need for an Apex Developer for our direct client in Los Alamos, NM for a 3-6 month contract. The ideal candidate will be a member of the SAE-2’s group and will be responsible for the analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and documentation of custom built applications. The candidate must have extensive programming experience, excellent organization skills, and the ability to multi-task. The successful candidate should also have be an expert in their field, and the willingness to provide knowledge transfer session. Finally, the candidate must be a highly motivated software developer with extensive experience in Oracle Apex, SQL, PLSQL, JQuery, JavaScript, and RESTful Services.
 Job Requirements: 
 Experience in developing Oracle Application Express applications in version 4.x/5.x
 Experience with Oracle database development (SQL and PLSQL)
 Experience with JQuery and JavaScript libraries
 In-depth knowledge of HTML 5, CSS, JSON, and AJAX framework
 Experience with mobile application development and ability to create RESTful services
 Experience in complex, large scale true web application development
 Strong designing, development and trouble shooting skills
 Be an excellent team player and independently able to research and provide resolute on for production support
 Desired Skills: 
 Ability to assess the impact of software upgrades and other environment changes
 Demonstrated effective interpersonal skills for communicating technical information and building relationships with customers
 Extensive experience with software configuration management; software quality assurance methodologies
 Demonstrated experience analyzing and defining business requirements and preparing technical designs
 Complete understanding in Oracle database design relationships and data modeling including performance tuning
 Strong multitasking capabilities and the ability to work on multiple projects/issues simultaneously
 Experience with build tools (example: Ant, Maven, Gradle)
 Linux Administration skills, including firewall configuration and Samba file server configuration
 Extensive experience providing support to Oracle EBS 12.* in either the HRMS, Procurement or Financial modules
 Experience implementing TCP/IP sockets
 Experience implementing data acquisition
 Familiarity with KepWare
 Familiarity with LabView
 Experience automating testing of web applications with Selenium
 Active DOE Q clearance


 Contact Immediately : Allan: 408-724-9764
